speaker_role: unknown (educational YouTube channel presenter, appears to be an accounting/finance educator, not identified as an admissions or financial aid professional)
key_insights: CSS Profile is run by the College Board and can be filed starting October 1; FAFSA is run by the federal government and opens January 1 (per video; FAFSA timing has since changed)
CSS Profile charges a fee (with waivers for low-income families); FAFSA is free for everyone
CSS Profile is only required by some schools (mostly private/selective); FAFSA is required by essentially any school that awards federal aid

CSS Profile uses 'institutional methodology' to determine a school's own grant/scholarship aid; FAFSA uses federal methodology to calculate expected family contribution for federal aid like Pell Grants
CSS Profile considers both custodial and non-custodial (e.g., divorced) parents' finances; FAFSA only considers the custodial parent's household
CSS Profile may assume a standard student summer earnings contribution; FAFSA does not
CSS Profile counts home equity in the family's financial position; FAFSA does not consider home equity at all

FAFSA has a simplified needs test that can exempt lower-income families from asset reporting; CSS Profile has no equivalent, and looks at all assets including farm and business equity more strictly (with some exceptions for family farms/small businesses under FAFSA)
specific_numbers_or_facts: CSS Profile filing opens October 1 (per video)
FAFSA filing opens January 1 (per video; note FAFSA timing has changed in more recent cycles)
FAFSA farm-equity exemption applies if the family lives on and materially participates in operating the farm
FAFSA excludes business equity if family owns more than 50% of a business with 100 or fewer employees
notable_or_distinctive: Provides an unusually detailed side-by-side of exactly which assets (home equity, non-custodial parent income, farm/business equity, summer earnings) each form does or doesn't count, beyond the basic fee/timing differences most videos cover.
reliability_notes: Older video (published about 10 years before this summary was written per channel metadata); FAFSA opening date and methodology details may be outdated given more recent FAFSA simplification changes, so figures should be verified against current-year FAFSA/CSS Profile rules.
